Gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST): The presence of a well-defined mass in the anal canal with spindle cell proliferation, nuclear palisading, and diffuse positivity for KIT protein and CD34, suggests GIST.
Leiomyoma: The absence of nuclear atypia and low mitotic count, along with the circumscribed nature of the mass, could also suggest a leiomyoma, although the positivity for KIT and CD34 is more characteristic of GIST.
